prompt: What was the birthday of the man who was mayor of New York City the year Snoopy debuted in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade?
answer: John V. Lindsay was mayor of New York City when Snoopy debuted in the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade in 1968. He was born on **November 24, 1921**.
